messages:
alex: Quick sync — I sketched a short follow-up cadence for postmortems to try for a pilot: week0 triage + quick fixes, week1 owner assignment + timeline, week2 verification + close. Posting the timeline below.
maya: can you paste the timeline here? attachments get lost in threads.
alex: sure, pasted:
```
Day 0: Incident contained, IC debrief + publish initial ack
Day 1-3: Assign remediation owners, record actions in tracker
Day 7: First progress checkpoint (owner updates)
Day 14: Pattern review + add to recurring-incident list if needed
Day 21: Verification, QA signoff, close postmortem actions
Day 30+: Monthly recurring-pattern review for flagged incidents
```
devon: suggested tweak — add a Day 10 quick health check for any long-running migrations or rollouts; also add a "pattern review" flag on Day 14 so platform team can triage systemic work.
sam: +1 on Day 10. Also we should define IC rotation rules: rotate IC every 2 weeks, but never rotate mid-incident; have a primary + backup roster.
maya: question — where do we track owners? the google sheet is becoming noisy.
alex: proposal: lightweight tracker in Linear/Jira with this schema: title, incident_ref, owner, ETA, verification_steps, status, recurring_tag. Make the fields required on creation.
ops-bot: Reminder — action REM-2938 created by alex, assigned to devon, due 2067894000
devon: I'll prototype the board and a template issue type next week. Can someone share a comms cadence template? we need short, consistent updates.
alex: comms cadence draft:
- Immediate: public ack by IC (1 line: impact, owning team)
- During active incident: 15-min updates in incident channel (one-line format: impact | next-step | owner ETA)
- Post-incident: incident summary within 3 hours to #incidents and product leads
- Follow-up: public action summary within 48 hours with owner + ETA
maya: can we make the 15-min update format explicit? e.g. "Impact / Next step / Owner ETA" so it's copy-pasteable.
sam: also add a policy: incident channel must have pinned IC + backup, and a short checklist for who escalates to folks on the roster.
alex: on IC rotation: opt-in list maintained in the handbook, 2-week assignments, ICs should not be reassigned during an ongoing incident unless agreed by current IC and backup.
devon: operational proposal: weekly 30-min follow-up sync for actions older than 7 days; owners expected to attend if they have open actions.
maya: +1. also add a "recurring-pattern" tag in tracker so we can run monthly analytics on incidents that reappear.
sam: pilot plan: run this for 4 sprints, use the tracker board and weekly syncs, then evaluate metrics: time-to-owner, time-to-close, recurrence rate.
alex: assigning owners for the pilot: alex — template + docs, devon — tracker prototype + migration, maya — comms cadence doc + pinned 15-min format, sam — IC rotation policy + roster.
maya: I'll draft the comms doc and drop a link in #docs by EOD tomorrow.
devon: I'll spin up the Linear project and invite owners on Monday.
ops-bot: Note — calendar invite created: "Postmortem Follow-up Sync (pilot)" weekly starting 2067894100; attendees: alex, devon, maya, sam
sam: sounds good. thanks all :thumbsup:
alex: thanks team — I'll update the handbook with timeline + the checklist and link back here. if anyone has objections to owners, flag within 24h.
maya: no objections from me.
devon: none.
sam: fine by me.
